resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register, Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com describe different first structures: a 1919 platform in a tree (Idaho Fire Lookouts, firelookout.com, Kemnow) and a roofed platform with a ground house (register). The steel tower is dated 1935 by three sources and 1934 by Kemnow's site.
The register gives the tower as 74 feet, which no other source supports. Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com both give 45 feet, which the record's 13.7 m follows.

notes_for_editor: Height and first-structure descriptions conflict; the register's 74-foot figure is an outlier. Distance from Council differs: firelookout.com gives 10 miles, and a 1954 USGS station description quoted on Kemnow's site gives 12.5 miles (used in the story with that attribution). The 2006 date is in the report's header, as checked 2026-10-09. The motorcycle check-in is a visitor's report, so treat its condition note as informal. No source read describes the site as it stands now.
